_comment: Tailwind entropy allowlist — exceptions to governance rules with documented justification.
_docs: See docs/tailwind-governance.md §Allowlist Policy. Every entry requires: rule, file, pattern, reason, reviewer, expires.
_review_cadence: Quarterly. Remove entries that are no longer needed.

entries.reason: Development overlay must sit above all other UI. Only rendered in dev mode.
entries.why_safe: Component is dev-only, never ships to production. Does not interfere with user flows.

entries.reason: Gallery container needs fixed height for image crop aspect ratio consistency.
entries.why_safe: Gallery is image-only context, not translated text. Locale-agnostic.

entries.reason: Gallery full-size container height. Image-only, not locale-sensitive.
entries.why_safe: Image container. No translated content. Consistent visual behavior needed.

entries.reason: Static gallery frame height for LCP optimization. Needs fixed height to prevent CLS.
entries.why_safe: LCP-critical image container. Changing this height would worsen CLS and Lighthouse scores.
